assumption: Fixed endpoint-union comparison frame chosen before selecting a delta subset
role: Makes absence explicit and prevents subset-dependent coordinate disappearance.
failure_if_removed: Hidden or subset-dependent visibility can admit substitutes or incomparable minima.

assumption: Complete key-addressed evidence at every visible layer
role: Makes equality coordinate-sensitive rather than value/class-only.
failure_if_removed: Value-only equality permits alternative singleton explanations.

assumption: Deterministic traversal and classification from endpoint evidence
role: Lets exact evidence equality imply the same finding and drift class.
failure_if_removed: Nondeterministic ordering or classification would make replay equality unstable.

assumption: Stable identities / coordinate correspondence across endpoints
role: Allows old, hybrid, and new observations to share coordinates.
failure_if_removed: Identity swaps can preserve positional tuples while changing meaning.

assumption: Pairwise-disjoint observable atom footprints (one net writer per coordinate)
role: Makes selecting more atoms unable to undo a required final coordinate.

assumption: Delta completeness: applying all atoms reconstructs the new endpoint semantically
role: Establishes that the full set is sufficient and anchors deletion queries.
failure_if_removed: An omitted endpoint difference can make the target unreachable.

assumption: Old and new finite versions validate before analysis or cache reuse
role: Excludes malformed identities, aliases, and unsupported values.
failure_if_removed: A malformed old endpoint can poison reused cache entries.

assumption: Correct old cache covering the endpoint-union candidate space
role: Justifies reuse outside the conservative impact set.
failure_if_removed: Missing or stale entries can silently disagree with full evaluation.

assumption: Structure-blind algorithm has only Boolean membership-query access and no supplied support for identification
role: Defines the information and task of the d-query identification lower bound.
failure_if_removed: A supplied candidate changes the task to verification with candidate-relative query bounds.

assumption: Source patching commutes with extraction and source observations factor through finite evidence
role: Required only to lift the finite theorem to a source language.
failure_if_removed: Without commutation/sound observation, a finite certificate says nothing about source semantics.

assumption: Principal-filter promise for the identical oracle in both identification and verification
role: Turns candidate sufficiency plus own-deletion necessity into equality with the unique least support.
failure_if_removed: Upward closure alone certifies only inclusion-minimality and can admit incomparable singleton supports.
